value: When the binding stones are broken, the completion text says the tortured souls can rest. It gives Trebor the mercy he had sought for his soldiers, though the count remains unsettled by the separate nineteen-men line. The story pauses over that release without supplying names for the dead or turning each stone into a separate battle. A long burden has eased; the power behind the chains still stands.
editorNote: The release is sourced. The ensemble art is interpretive and does not claim a named roster or the exact number of depicted spirits.
